questions.prompt: Which decorator turns a class into a component?

options.text: @Injectable
@Component
@Directive
@Pipe

questions.explanation: @Component links a class to its template, styles, and selector.

questions.prompt: How do you read the value of a signal input declared as name = input<string>()?

options.text: name
name()
name.value
this.name.get()

questions.explanation: Signal inputs are read-only signals, so you call them to read the current value, in templates and in code.

questions.prompt: How does a child component tell its parent that something happened?

options.text: It changes the value of its input
It declares an output() and calls .emit(value); the parent listens with (eventName)="handler($event)"
It injects the parent component and calls its methods
It writes to a global variable

questions.explanation: Data flows down through inputs and events flow up through outputs, which keeps the data flow predictable.

questions.prompt: Why use routerLink instead of href for links inside the app?

options.text: href does not work in Angular templates
routerLink navigates on the client without reloading the page
routerLink makes links open in a new tab
routerLink is required for SEO

questions.explanation: A plain href triggers a full page reload. routerLink lets the Router swap the page component inside <router-outlet />.

questions.prompt: Which provideRouter feature binds a route parameter like :id to a matching component input? provideRouter(routes, ____())
questions.explanation: withComponentInputBinding() passes route params (and query params and resolved data) into inputs with the same name.

questions.prompt: Which statements about loadComponent in a route are true? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: It downloads the page's code the first time the route is visited
It requires the page to be declared in an NgModule
It keeps the initial bundle smaller
It renders the page twice

questions.explanation: loadComponent lazy-loads a standalone component, so its code is only downloaded when the user first navigates there.
